descriptionVi: 20 từ cần biết cho chuyến đi đầu tiên: vé, hành lý, điểm đến.
descriptionEn: 20 must-know words for your first trip: tickets, luggage and destinations.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place
cards.example: I bought two train tickets online.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi đã mua hai vé tàu trực tuyến.

cards.meaningEn: an official document that lets you travel to other countries
cards.example: Don't forget your passport at home.
cards.exampleMeaning: Đừng để quên hộ chiếu ở nhà.

cards.meaningEn: bags and suitcases you take on a trip
cards.example: My luggage is very heavy.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hành lý của tôi rất nặng.

cards.meaningEn: a large case for carrying clothes when travelling
cards.example: She packed a small suitcase.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cô ấy xếp một chiếc va li nhỏ.

cards.meaningEn: a drawing of an area showing roads and places
cards.example: Can you show me the city on the map?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn chỉ giúp tôi thành phố trên bản đồ được không?

cards.meaningEn: a person who visits a place for pleasure
cards.example: The beach is full of tourists in summer.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bãi biển đầy khách du lịch vào mùa hè.

cards.meaningEn: the act of travelling from one place to another
cards.example: The journey to Da Nang took six hours.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chuyến đi đến Đà Nẵng mất sáu tiếng.

cards.meaningEn: the place where someone is going
cards.example: Our final destination is Hoi An.
cards.exampleMeaning: Điểm đến cuối cùng của chúng tôi là Hội An.

cards.meaningEn: to arrange to have a seat, room or ticket in advance
cards.example: I want to book a table for four.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi muốn đặt một bàn cho bốn người.

cards.meaningEn: a situation where something happens later than planned
cards.example: There is a two-hour delay for this flight.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chuyến bay này bị chậm hai tiếng.

cards.meaningEn: the raised area where passengers get on a train
cards.example: The train leaves from platform 3.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tàu khởi hành từ sân ga số 3.

cards.meaningEn: to reach a place at the end of a journey
cards.example: We arrive in Hue at noon.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi đến Huế vào buổi trưa.

cards.meaningEn: to leave a place, especially at the start of a trip
cards.example: The bus departs at 7 a.m.
cards.exampleMeaning: Xe buýt khởi hành lúc 7 giờ sáng.

cards.meaningEn: something you buy to remember a place you visited
cards.example: I bought a small souvenir for my mother.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi mua một món quà lưu niệm nhỏ cho mẹ.

cards.meaningEn: visiting interesting places as a tourist
cards.example: We spent the day sightseeing in Hanoi.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi dành cả ngày đi tham quan Hà Nội.

cards.meaningEn: a list of the times when buses or trains leave
cards.example: Check the timetable before you go.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy xem lịch trình trước khi đi.

cards.meaningEn: for travel in one direction only
cards.example: A one-way ticket to Saigon, please.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho tôi một vé một chiều đi Sài Gòn.

cards.meaningEn: a ticket for going somewhere and coming back
cards.example: A return ticket is cheaper than two single ones.
cards.exampleMeaning: Vé khứ hồi rẻ hơn hai vé một chiều.

cards.meaningEn: the money you pay for a journey
cards.example: The bus fare is only ten thousand dong.
cards.exampleMeaning: Giá vé xe buýt chỉ có mười nghìn đồng.

cards.meaningEn: in or to a foreign country
cards.example: She has never been abroad.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cô ấy chưa từng ra nước ngoài.

descriptionVi: Từ vựng khi làm thủ tục bay, nhận phòng và trả phòng khách sạn.
descriptionEn: Vocabulary for checking in at the airport and staying at a hotel.

cards.meaningEn: a card that allows you to get on a plane
cards.example: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.
cards.exampleMeaning: Vui lòng xuất trình thẻ lên máy bay tại cổng.

cards.meaningEn: the exit where passengers board a plane
cards.example: Your departure gate is B12.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cổng khởi hành của bạn là B12.

cards.meaningEn: the place where officials check goods entering a country
cards.example: We waited in line at customs for an hour.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi xếp hàng chờ ở hải quan một tiếng.

cards.meaningEn: a short stop between two flights
cards.example: I have a three-hour layover in Seoul.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi có ba tiếng quá cảnh ở Seoul.

cards.meaningEn: a small bag you take into the plane cabin
cards.example: Only one carry-on is allowed per passenger.
cards.exampleMeaning: Mỗi hành khách chỉ được mang một hành lý xách tay.

cards.meaningEn: the area where you collect your bags after a flight
cards.example: Meet me at the baggage claim.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hẹn gặp tôi ở khu nhận hành lý.

cards.meaningVi: làm thủ tục nhận phòng / lên máy bay
cards.meaningEn: to register on arrival at a hotel or an airport
cards.example: You can check in from two o'clock.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn có thể nhận phòng từ hai giờ chiều.

cards.meaningEn: to pay and leave a hotel
cards.example: We need to check out before noon.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi cần trả phòng trước buổi trưa.

cards.meaningEn: an arrangement to keep a room or table for you
cards.example: I have a reservation under the name Linh.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi có đặt phòng dưới tên Linh.

cards.meaningEn: a hotel room for one person
cards.example: A single room costs forty dollars a night.
cards.exampleMeaning: Một phòng đơn giá bốn mươi đô mỗi đêm.

cards.meaningEn: a hotel room with a bed for two people
cards.example: We would like a double room with a view.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi muốn một phòng đôi có view đẹp.

cards.meaningEn: given free as a courtesy
cards.example: Breakfast is complimentary for all guests.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bữa sáng miễn phí cho mọi khách.

cards.meaningEn: the department that cleans hotel rooms
cards.example: Please call housekeeping for extra towels.
cards.exampleMeaning: Vui lòng gọi bộ phận buồng phòng để xin thêm khăn.

cards.meaningEn: useful features of a hotel such as a pool or gym
cards.example: The hotel offers many amenities.
cards.exampleMeaning: Khách sạn có nhiều tiện nghi.

cards.meaningEn: a room that is available
cards.example: Sorry, we have no vacancies tonight.
cards.exampleMeaning: Xin lỗi, tối nay chúng tôi hết phòng trống.

cards.meaningEn: money paid in advance to secure a booking
cards.example: You must pay a fifty-dollar deposit.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn phải trả năm mươi đô tiền đặt cọc.

cards.meaningEn: the place or act of changing money into another currency
cards.example: Is there a currency exchange in the terminal?
cards.exampleMeaning: Trong nhà ga có chỗ đổi tiền không?

cards.meaningEn: a detailed plan of a journey
cards.example: Our itinerary includes three cities.
cards.exampleMeaning: Lịch trình của chúng tôi gồm ba thành phố.

cards.meaningEn: an official stamp that lets you enter a country
cards.example: You need a visa to visit that country.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn cần thị thực để đến thăm nước đó.

cards.meaningEn: sudden movements of air that shake a plane
cards.example: The plane hit turbulence over the sea.
cards.exampleMeaning: Máy bay gặp nhiễu động trên biển.

descriptionVi: Các từ thường dùng khi đi ăn ngoài: thực đơn, gọi món, thanh toán.
descriptionEn: Everyday words for eating out: menu, ordering and paying.

cards.meaningEn: a list of dishes you can order
cards.example: Could I see the menu, please?
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho tôi xem thực đơn được không?

cards.meaningEn: a man who serves food in a restaurant
cards.example: The waiter brought us some water.
cards.exampleMeaning: Người phục vụ mang nước cho chúng tôi.

cards.meaningEn: to ask for food or drink in a restaurant
cards.example: I'd like to order the chicken soup.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi muốn gọi món súp gà.

cards.meaningEn: a paper showing how much you must pay
cards.example: Can we have the bill, please?
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho chúng tôi xin hoá đơn.

cards.meaningEn: extra money given to a waiter for good service
cards.example: We left a small tip on the table.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi để lại một ít tiền boa trên bàn.

cards.meaningEn: a small dish eaten before the main course
cards.example: We shared a spring roll as an appetizer.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi chia nhau một cuốn chả giò làm món khai vị.

cards.meaningEn: the largest dish of a meal
cards.example: For the main course I chose grilled fish.
cards.exampleMeaning: Món chính tôi chọn cá nướng.

cards.meaningEn: a sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal
cards.example: Do you want dessert or coffee?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn muốn ăn tráng miệng hay uống cà phê?

cards.meaningEn: containing strong flavours from chilli or pepper
cards.example: This soup is too spicy for me.
cards.exampleMeaning: Món súp này quá cay với tôi.

cards.meaningEn: having a very pleasant taste
cards.example: The noodles were absolutely delicious.
cards.exampleMeaning: Món mì ngon tuyệt.

cards.meaningEn: not containing or eating meat
cards.example: Do you have any vegetarian dishes?
cards.exampleMeaning: Ở đây có món chay nào không?

cards.meaningEn: a drink such as tea, juice or soda
cards.example: What beverage would you like with lunch?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn muốn uống gì với bữa trưa?

cards.meaningEn: a round deep dish for soup or rice
cards.example: She filled a bowl with rice.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cô ấy xới đầy một bát cơm.

cards.meaningEn: two thin sticks used to eat food in East Asia
cards.example: He is learning how to use chopsticks.
cards.exampleMeaning: Anh ấy đang học cách dùng đũa.

cards.meaningEn: a tool with points used to lift food
cards.example: Could I have a clean fork?
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho tôi xin một cái nĩa sạch được không?

cards.meaningEn: a tool with a small bowl used to eat soup
cards.example: Use a spoon for the soup.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy dùng thìa để ăn súp.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of cloth or paper for wiping your mouth
cards.example: Please pass me a napkin.
cards.exampleMeaning: Làm ơn đưa tôi một cái khăn ăn.

cards.meaningEn: a liquid food made by boiling meat or vegetables
cards.example: The soup is hot, be careful.
cards.exampleMeaning: Món súp đang nóng, cẩn thận nhé.

cards.meaningEn: feeling that you want to eat
cards.example: I'm so hungry after the long walk.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi đói quá sau chuyến đi bộ dài.

cards.meaningEn: food you buy in a restaurant and eat elsewhere
cards.example: Two coffees for takeaway, please.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho hai cà phê mang đi.

descriptionVi: Động từ nấu nướng và đồ dùng trong bếp.
descriptionEn: Cooking verbs and common kitchen items.

cards.meaningEn: to heat a liquid until it bubbles
cards.example: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
cards.exampleMeaning: Luộc trứng trong mười phút.

cards.meaningEn: to cook food in hot oil
cards.example: She fried some fish for dinner.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cô ấy chiên cá cho bữa tối.

cards.meaningEn: to cook food in an oven
cards.example: I like to bake bread on Sundays.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi thích nướng bánh mì vào Chủ nhật.

cards.meaningEn: to cut something into small pieces
cards.example: Chop the onions finely.
cards.exampleMeaning: Băm nhỏ hành tây.

cards.meaningEn: to cut into thin flat pieces
cards.example: Slice the tomatoes for the salad.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cắt cà chua thành lát cho món salad.

cards.meaningEn: to mix food with a spoon
cards.example: Stir the sauce slowly.
cards.exampleMeaning: Khuấy nước sốt từ từ.

cards.meaningEn: to make a liquid flow out of a container
cards.example: Pour the milk into the glass.
cards.exampleMeaning: Rót sữa vào cốc.

cards.meaningEn: to combine things together
cards.example: Mix the flour and the eggs.
cards.exampleMeaning: Trộn bột với trứng.

cards.meaningEn: instructions for cooking a particular dish
cards.example: This recipe is easy to follow.
cards.exampleMeaning: Công thức này dễ làm theo.

cards.meaningEn: one of the foods used to make a dish
cards.example: What are the main ingredients?
cards.exampleMeaning: Các nguyên liệu chính là gì?

cards.meaningEn: a closed box for baking food
cards.example: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
cards.exampleMeaning: Làm nóng lò nướng ở 180 độ.

cards.meaningEn: a device with burners for cooking
cards.example: Turn off the stove when you leave.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy tắt bếp khi bạn ra khỏi nhà.

cards.meaningEn: a flat metal dish used for frying
cards.example: Heat some oil in a pan.
cards.exampleMeaning: Đun nóng ít dầu trong chảo.

cards.meaningEn: a deep round container for cooking
cards.example: Put the rice in the pot.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho gạo vào nồi.

cards.meaningEn: a tool with a sharp edge for cutting
cards.example: Be careful with that sharp knife.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cẩn thận với con dao sắc đó.

cards.meaningEn: a thick liquid served with food
cards.example: Would you like some chilli sauce?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn có muốn thêm tương ớt không?

cards.meaningEn: a white substance used to flavour food
cards.example: The soup needs a little more salt.
cards.exampleMeaning: Món súp cần thêm chút muối.

cards.meaningEn: a hot-tasting powder used to flavour food
cards.example: Add some black pepper.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cho thêm chút tiêu đen.

cards.meaningEn: recently made or picked; not old
cards.example: We only use fresh vegetables.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi chỉ dùng rau tươi.

cards.meaningEn: not cooked
cards.example: Don't eat raw meat.
cards.exampleMeaning: Đừng ăn thịt sống.

descriptionVi: Hỏi giá, trả giá, thanh toán và đổi trả hàng.
descriptionEn: Asking prices, bargaining, paying and returning goods.

cards.meaningEn: the amount of money you pay for something
cards.example: What is the price of this shirt?
cards.exampleMeaning: Chiếc áo này giá bao nhiêu?

cards.meaningEn: a reduction in the usual price
cards.example: They give a ten percent discount to students.
cards.exampleMeaning: Họ giảm giá mười phần trăm cho sinh viên.

cards.meaningEn: low in price
cards.example: These shoes are cheap but good.
cards.exampleMeaning: Đôi giày này rẻ mà vẫn tốt.

cards.meaningEn: costing a lot of money
cards.example: That laptop is too expensive for me.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chiếc laptop đó quá đắt với tôi.

cards.meaningEn: money in the form of notes and coins
cards.example: Do you pay in cash or by card?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn trả bằng tiền mặt hay thẻ?

cards.meaningEn: a paper showing that you have paid
cards.example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy giữ biên lai phòng khi bạn cần đổi trả.

cards.meaningEn: a person who takes payments in a shop
cards.example: Please pay at the cashier.
cards.exampleMeaning: Vui lòng thanh toán tại quầy thu ngân.

cards.meaningEn: a person who buys goods or services
cards.example: The shop has many regular customers.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cửa hàng có nhiều khách quen.

cards.meaningEn: something bought for less than its usual price
cards.example: At that price, it's a real bargain.
cards.exampleMeaning: Với giá đó thì đúng là món hời.

cards.meaningEn: money that is paid back to you
cards.example: I asked for a refund because it was broken.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi yêu cầu hoàn tiền vì nó bị hỏng.

cards.meaningEn: a period when goods are sold at lower prices
cards.example: Everything is on sale this weekend.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cuối tuần này mọi thứ đều giảm giá.

cards.meaningEn: how big or small something is
cards.example: Do you have this in a larger size?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn có cái này cỡ lớn hơn không?

cards.meaningEn: to be the right size for someone
cards.example: These jeans don't fit me anymore.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chiếc quần jeans này không còn vừa với tôi nữa.

cards.meaningEn: to put on clothes to see if they fit
cards.example: Can I try on this jacket?
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi mặc thử áo khoác này được không?

cards.meaningEn: a plastic card used to buy things and pay later
cards.example: Do you accept credit cards?
cards.exampleMeaning: Ở đây có nhận thẻ tín dụng không?

cards.meaningEn: money returned when you pay more than the price
cards.example: Keep the change.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn cứ giữ lại tiền thừa.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of paper that gives you a discount
cards.example: I have a coupon for free delivery.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi có phiếu giảm giá miễn phí giao hàng.

cards.meaningEn: a name of a product made by a particular company
cards.example: This brand is popular among teenagers.
cards.exampleMeaning: Thương hiệu này được thanh thiếu niên ưa chuộng.

cards.meaningEn: a line of people waiting for something
cards.example: There was a long queue at the checkout.
cards.exampleMeaning: Có một hàng dài ở quầy thanh toán.

cards.meaningEn: to have enough money to buy something
cards.example: I can't afford a new phone right now.
cards.exampleMeaning: Lúc này tôi không đủ tiền mua điện thoại mới.

descriptionVi: Tên các loại trang phục và cách mô tả phong cách ăn mặc.
descriptionEn: Names of clothing and words to describe style.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of clothing for the upper body with a collar
cards.example: He wears a white shirt to work.
cards.exampleMeaning: Anh ấy mặc áo sơ mi trắng đi làm.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of clothing that covers the legs
cards.example: These trousers are too long.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chiếc quần dài này quá dài.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of clothing for women with a top and skirt joined
cards.example: She wore a red dress to the party.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cô ấy mặc chiếc váy đỏ đi dự tiệc.

cards.meaningEn: a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist
cards.example: The school skirt is dark blue.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chân váy đồng phục màu xanh đậm.

cards.meaningEn: a short coat
cards.example: Take a jacket, it may get cold.
cards.exampleMeaning: Mang theo áo khoác, trời có thể lạnh.

cards.meaningEn: a long warm piece of clothing worn outside
cards.example: I need a warm coat for winter.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi cần một chiếc áo choàng ấm cho mùa đông.

cards.meaningEn: a warm knitted top
cards.example: Grandma knitted me a green sweater.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bà đan cho tôi một chiếc áo len xanh.

cards.meaningEn: coverings for the feet, usually with a hard sole
cards.example: I bought new shoes for school.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi mua giày mới để đi học.

cards.meaningEn: soft coverings for the feet worn inside shoes
cards.example: Put on your socks first.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy đi tất trước đã.

cards.meaningEn: a covering for the head
cards.example: Wear a hat under the hot sun.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy đội mũ dưới nắng gắt.

cards.meaningEn: a long piece of cloth worn around the neck
cards.example: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cô ấy quấn chiếc khăn quanh cổ.

cards.meaningEn: coverings for the hands
cards.example: Don't forget your gloves in winter.
cards.exampleMeaning: Đừng quên găng tay vào mùa đông.

cards.meaningEn: a strip of leather worn around the waist
cards.example: He needs a belt for these trousers.
cards.exampleMeaning: Anh ấy cần một chiếc thắt lưng cho quần này.

cards.meaningEn: special clothes worn by members of a group
cards.example: Students must wear a uniform.
cards.exampleMeaning: Học sinh phải mặc đồng phục.

cards.meaningEn: popular at a particular time
cards.example: Those sunglasses are very fashionable.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chiếc kính râm đó rất hợp thời trang.

cards.meaningEn: relaxed and not formal
cards.example: I prefer casual clothes on weekends.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi thích quần áo giản dị vào cuối tuần.

cards.meaningEn: suitable for official or serious occasions
cards.example: A suit is formal clothing.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bộ vest là trang phục trang trọng.

cards.meaningEn: a repeated design on a surface
cards.example: I like the flower pattern on this dress.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi thích hoạ tiết hoa trên chiếc váy này.

cards.meaningEn: cloth used for making clothes
cards.example: Cotton is a soft and cool fabric.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cotton là loại vải mềm và mát.

cards.meaningEn: to have clothes or jewellery on your body
cards.example: What are you going to wear tonight?
cards.exampleMeaning: Tối nay bạn định mặc gì?

descriptionVi: Gọi tên các thành viên trong gia đình và mối quan hệ họ hàng.
descriptionEn: Naming family members and describing relationships.

cards.meaningEn: your mother and father
cards.example: My parents live in Hue.
cards.exampleMeaning: Bố mẹ tôi sống ở Huế.

cards.meaningEn: the parents of your parents
cards.example: I visit my grandparents every summer.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tôi thăm ông bà vào mỗi mùa hè.

cards.meaningEn: a brother or a sister
cards.example: Do you have any siblings?
cards.exampleMeaning: Bạn có anh chị em ruột không?

cards.meaningEn: a child of your uncle or aunt
cards.example: My cousin is studying in Canada.
cards.exampleMeaning: Anh họ tôi đang học ở Canada.

cards.meaningEn: the brother of your parent
cards.example: My uncle works as a driver.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chú tôi làm nghề lái xe.

cards.meaningEn: the sister of your parent
cards.example: My aunt makes delicious cakes.
cards.exampleMeaning: Dì tôi làm bánh rất ngon.

cards.meaningEn: the son of your brother or sister
cards.example: My nephew is five years old.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cháu trai tôi năm tuổi.

cards.meaningEn: the daughter of your brother or sister
cards.example: My niece loves drawing.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cháu gái tôi thích vẽ.

cards.meaningEn: a husband or wife
cards.example: Please write your spouse's name here.
cards.exampleMeaning: Vui lòng ghi tên vợ hoặc chồng của bạn ở đây.

cards.meaningEn: a member of your family
cards.example: Many relatives came to the wedding.
cards.exampleMeaning: Nhiều họ hàng đã đến dự đám cưới.

cards.meaningEn: a man who is married
cards.example: Her husband is a doctor.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chồng cô ấy là bác sĩ.

cards.meaningEn: a woman who is married
cards.example: His wife teaches English.
cards.exampleMeaning: Vợ anh ấy dạy tiếng Anh.

cards.meaningEn: one of two children born at the same time

cards.meaningEn: an organised collection of data
cards.example: All user data is stored in a database.
cards.exampleMeaning: Mọi dữ liệu người dùng được lưu trong cơ sở dữ liệu.

cards.meaningEn: a computer that provides data to other computers
cards.example: The server is down again.
cards.exampleMeaning: Máy chủ lại bị sập rồi.

cards.example: I found a bug in the login page.

cards.meaningEn: to find and fix errors in a program
cards.example: It took hours to debug the code.
cards.exampleMeaning: Phải mất nhiều giờ để gỡ lỗi đoạn mã.

cards.meaningEn: a set of steps for solving a problem
cards.example: This algorithm sorts numbers quickly.
cards.exampleMeaning: Thuật toán này sắp xếp số rất nhanh.

cards.meaningEn: a ready-made structure for building software
cards.example: React is a popular framework.
cards.exampleMeaning: React là một khung phát triển phổ biến.

cards.meaningEn: to put software into use on a server
cards.example: We deploy the app every Friday.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi triển khai ứng dụng vào mỗi thứ Sáu.

cards.meaningEn: a place where code is stored and managed

cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy đẩy thay đổi của bạn lên kho mã nguồn.

cards.meaningVi: giao diện lập trình ứng dụng
cards.meaningEn: a way for programs to talk to each other
cards.example: The app calls an API to get weather data.

cards.meaningEn: computers on the internet that store and run data
cards.example: Our files are saved in the cloud.
cards.exampleMeaning: Các tệp của chúng tôi được lưu trên đám mây.

cards.meaningEn: a system that blocks unwanted network traffic
cards.example: The firewall blocked the suspicious request.
cards.exampleMeaning: Tường lửa đã chặn yêu cầu đáng ngờ.

cards.meaningEn: changing data into a secret code
cards.example: Encryption protects your passwords.
cards.exampleMeaning: Mã hoá bảo vệ mật khẩu của bạn.

cards.meaningEn: the amount of data that can be sent at one time
cards.example: Video calls use a lot of bandwidth.
cards.exampleMeaning: Cuộc gọi video dùng rất nhiều băng thông.

cards.meaningEn: computers connected to share information
cards.example: The office network is very slow today.
cards.exampleMeaning: Mạng của văn phòng hôm nay rất chậm.

cards.meaningEn: a program used to view web pages
cards.example: Try opening the site in another browser.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy thử mở trang trong trình duyệt khác.

cards.meaningEn: a copy of data kept in case of loss
cards.example: Always make a backup before updating.
cards.exampleMeaning: Luôn tạo bản sao lưu trước khi cập nhật.

cards.meaningEn: a new version that improves a program
cards.example: Install the latest update today.
cards.exampleMeaning: Hãy cài bản cập nhật mới nhất hôm nay.

cards.meaningEn: the process of proving who you are
cards.example: Two-factor authentication improves security.
cards.exampleMeaning: Xác thực hai yếu tố giúp tăng cường bảo mật.

descriptionVi: Nhóm từ học thuật thường gặp trong bài đọc và bài viết trình độ B2-C1.
descriptionEn: Academic words common in B2-C1 reading and writing.

cards.meaningEn: to study something carefully in detail
cards.example: Researchers analysed the survey results.
cards.exampleMeaning: Các nhà nghiên cứu đã phân tích kết quả khảo sát.

cards.meaningEn: an idea about how something is or should be
cards.example: The concept of time is hard to define.
cards.exampleMeaning: Khái niệm về thời gian rất khó định nghĩa.

cards.meaningEn: facts that show something is true
cards.example: There is strong evidence for this theory.
cards.exampleMeaning: Có bằng chứng mạnh mẽ cho lý thuyết này.

cards.meaningEn: an idea that has not yet been proved
cards.example: The experiment supports our hypothesis.
cards.exampleMeaning: Thí nghiệm ủng hộ giả thuyết của chúng tôi.

cards.meaningEn: to explain the meaning of something
cards.example: Scientists interpret the data in different ways.
cards.exampleMeaning: Các nhà khoa học diễn giải dữ liệu theo nhiều cách.

cards.meaningEn: the system of methods used in a study
cards.example: The methodology is described in chapter two.
cards.exampleMeaning: Phương pháp luận được mô tả ở chương hai.

cards.meaningEn: large or important enough to be noticed
cards.example: There was a significant rise in temperature.
cards.exampleMeaning: Nhiệt độ đã tăng đáng kể.

cards.meaningEn: a set of ideas that explains something
cards.example: Einstein's theory changed physics.
cards.exampleMeaning: Lý thuyết của Einstein đã thay đổi vật lý học.

cards.meaningEn: to begin and be responsible for a task
cards.example: The team will undertake a two-year study.
cards.exampleMeaning: Nhóm sẽ tiến hành một nghiên cứu kéo dài hai năm.

cards.meaningEn: to obtain something from a source
cards.example: The word derives from Latin.
cards.exampleMeaning: Từ này bắt nguồn từ tiếng La-tinh.

cards.meaningEn: always behaving or happening in the same way
cards.example: The results were consistent across all tests.
cards.exampleMeaning: Kết quả nhất quán trong mọi bài kiểm tra.

cards.meaningEn: one of several things that influence a result
cards.example: Cost is an important factor.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chi phí là một yếu tố quan trọng.

cards.meaningEn: to show that something exists or is true
cards.example: Studies indicate that sleep improves memory.
cards.exampleMeaning: Các nghiên cứu chỉ ra rằng giấc ngủ cải thiện trí nhớ.

cards.meaningEn: something that exists and can be observed
cards.example: Global warming is a worrying phenomenon.
cards.exampleMeaning: Nóng lên toàn cầu là một hiện tượng đáng lo ngại.

cards.meaningEn: to keep something going over time
cards.example: It is hard to sustain economic growth.
cards.exampleMeaning: Rất khó để duy trì tăng trưởng kinh tế.

cards.meaningEn: to accept something is true without proof
cards.example: We assume the data is accurate.
cards.exampleMeaning: Chúng tôi cho rằng dữ liệu là chính xác.

cards.meaningEn: standards used to judge something
cards.example: The candidates met all the criteria.
cards.exampleMeaning: Các ứng viên đều đáp ứng mọi tiêu chí.

cards.meaningEn: to suggest something without saying it directly
cards.example: The results imply a link between the two.
cards.exampleMeaning: Kết quả ngụ ý có mối liên hệ giữa hai điều này.

cards.meaningEn: having more than one possible meaning
cards.example: The question was ambiguous.
cards.exampleMeaning: Câu hỏi này mơ hồ.

cards.meaningEn: based on observation rather than theory
cards.example: The study offers empirical evidence.
cards.exampleMeaning: Nghiên cứu đưa ra bằng chứng thực nghiệm.
